query:
-- Check current business type assignments
SELECT b.id, b.name, bt.name as bizType, bt.slug, sc.name as sport, b.region, b.hub 
FROM businesses b 
LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id 
LEFT JOIN sportCategories sc ON b.sportCategoryId = sc.id
ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 20;
